description: Create, update, or upload repository files. Actions: single (create/update one file with commit message), batch (atomic multi-file commit), upload (add attachment returning markdown link). Related: browse_files to read existing files.

action.description: Action to perform: single, batch, upload

author_email.description: Commit author email Required for 'single', 'batch' action(s).

author_name.description: Commit author name Required for 'single', 'batch' action(s).

branch.description: Target branch name Required for 'single', 'batch' action(s).

content.description: File content (text or base64 encoded) Required for 'single' action(s).

encoding.description: Content encoding (default: text) Required for 'single' action(s).

execute_filemode.description: Set executable permission Required for 'single' action(s).

file.description: Base64 encoded file content Required for 'upload' action(s).

file_path.description: Path to the file Required for 'single' action(s).

filename.description: Name of the file Required for 'upload' action(s).

files.description: Files to commit (at least one required) Required for 'batch' action(s).

last_commit_id.description: Last known commit ID for conflict detection Required for 'single' action(s).

overwrite.description: If true, automatically detect which files exist and update them, create others (requires pre-check for each file via GET requests). If false or omitted, only create new files (fails if any file exists). Use true when batch includes mix of new and existing files. Note: Non-404 errors during any pre-check will fail the entire batch. Required for 'single', 'batch' action(s).

start_branch.description: Base branch to start from Required for 'single', 'batch' action(s).

name: manage_files
